idea-plugin.name: Earl Grey UI Theme
idea-plugin.description: A gentle, low-contrast light theme for JetBrains IDEs, following the design principles of Earl Grey. Includes a matching editor color scheme, with Java highlighting matched to the Earl Grey VS Code theme, and solid-color Earl Grey icons.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
@VERSION@

  • Java highlighting matched token by token to the Earl Grey VS Code theme: classes, methods, type parameters, annotations, fields, constants, parameters, record components, Javadoc tags and punctuation.
  • Every Java color setting is defined by the scheme, so the whole editor stays in the Earl Grey palette.
  • Diff, search, inlay hint, inspection and console colors from the Earl Grey palette.
  • Earl Grey colors for the Rainbow Brackets (Lite) plugin; set its number of colors to 6 for matching bracket pair colors.
